title: たなばたさま (Tanabata-sama — Star Festival)
description: The classic song for Japan's Tanabata star festival celebrated on July 7th. Children write wishes on colorful strips of paper (tanzaku) and hang them from bamboo branches while singing about the stars Orihime and Hikoboshi meeting across the Milky Way. The imagery of golden and silver sand dust describes the glittering stars.
